mentions.name: Jupjup
mentions.description: A Chrome and Firefox extension for language learning that lets users save words and phrases from any website, Netflix, or YouTube, and review them with spaced repetition flashcards to remember them.
mentions.problem: Wanted a better way to make flashcards and learn vocabulary from the sites they visit, Netflix, and YouTube while learning Korean.
mentions.audience: Wanted a better way to make flashcards and learn vocabulary from the sites they visit, Netflix, and YouTube while learning Korean.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made Jupjup (https://getjupjup.com) as a chrome and Firefox extension that lets you save words and phrases from all over and then do spaced repetition to remember them.
